models.deep.convolutional.resnet module¶

Deep Residual Network (ResNet) - Network with skip connections

class models.deep.convolutional.resnet.DeepResNet(input_dim: int, hidden_dim: int = 128, num_blocks: int = 4, output_dim: int = 10, use_conv: bool = False, dropout: float = 0.1, kernel_size: int = 3, output_type: Literal['prediction', 'embedding'] = 'prediction')[source]¶

Bases: Module

Deep Residual Network (ResNet) for time series or sequence data.

ResNet uses skip connections to enable training of very deep networks by addressing the vanishing gradient problem.

Parameters:

  • input_dim – Input feature dimension

  • hidden_dim – Hidden dimension for residual blocks

  • num_blocks – Number of residual blocks

  • output_dim – Output dimension

  • use_conv – If True, use convolutional blocks; otherwise use fully connected

  • dropout – Dropout probability

  • output_type – ‘prediction’ returns final output, ‘embedding’ returns features

forward(x: Tensor, return_sequence: bool = False) → Tensor[source]¶

Forward pass through Deep ResNet.

Parameters:

  • x – Input tensor of shape (batch_size, seq_len, input_dim)

  • return_sequence – If True, return output for each timestep

Returns:

Output tensor of shape (batch_size, output_dim) or (batch_size, seq_len, output_dim)

class models.deep.convolutional.resnet.ResNetBottleneck(in_dim: int, bottleneck_dim: int, out_dim: int, use_conv: bool = False, dropout: float = 0.1)[source]¶

Bases: Module

Bottleneck Residual Block (used in deeper ResNets like ResNet-50).

Uses 1x1 conv to reduce dimensions, 3x3 conv for computation, then 1x1 conv to restore dimensions.

Parameters:

  • in_dim – Input dimension

  • bottleneck_dim – Bottleneck dimension (typically in_dim // 4)

  • out_dim – Output dimension

  • use_conv – If True, use Conv1d; otherwise use Linear

  • dropout – Dropout probability

forward(x: Tensor) → Tensor[source]¶

Forward pass with bottleneck skip connection.

class models.deep.convolutional.resnet.ResidualBlock(hidden_dim: int, use_conv: bool = False, dropout: float = 0.1, kernel_size: int = 3)[source]¶

Bases: Module

Basic Residual Block with skip connection.

Implements: output = activation(F(x) + x) where F(x) is a sequence of linear/conv layers.

Parameters:

  • hidden_dim – Dimension of the block

  • use_conv – If True, use Conv1d; otherwise use Linear

  • dropout – Dropout probability

forward(x: Tensor) → Tensor[source]¶

Forward pass with skip connection.

Parameters:

x – Input tensor

Returns:

Output with skip connection applied
